Agent.label: Agent
Agent.description: An AI agent does one job, like writing the narration or picking clips

Conditional.label: Conditional Branch
Conditional.description: Go one way or another depending on an earlier result

ForEach.label: For Each
ForEach.description: Repeat a step for each item in a list

ReviewLoop.label: Review Loop
ReviewLoop.description: Check the result and redo earlier steps until it is good enough

Parallel.label: Parallel
Parallel.description: Run several agents at the same time and combine their work

Extract.label: Extract
Extract.description: Trim earlier results down to what the next AI step needs

VideoAnalyze.label: Analyze Video
VideoAnalyze.description: Watch your footage: find shots, pauses and what is said

VideoCompile.label: Compile Video
VideoCompile.description: Put the final video together from the chosen clips

VideoGenerate.label: Generate Video
VideoGenerate.description: Generate new video clips from a description (paid, with a spending limit)

Voiceover.label: Voiceover
Voiceover.description: Read narration aloud with an AI voice

EditRoom.label: Edit Room
EditRoom.description: A team of AI editors discusses the footage and agrees on one cut

GraphicsRoom.label: Graphics Room
GraphicsRoom.description: A team of AI designers agrees on titles and graphics

ColorGradeRoom.label: Color Grade Room
ColorGradeRoom.description: A team of AI colourists agrees on one colour look

ThumbnailGenerate.label: Make Thumbnail
ThumbnailGenerate.description: Pick the best frame from your footage and save it as an image

Revise.label: Changes
Revise.description: Makes the changes you asked for to a finished video and renders it again.

DesignGraphic.label: Design a graphic
DesignGraphic.description: Designs one graphic for a picture, such as a title, badge or price tag.

DailiesRoom.label: Dailies Room
DailiesRoom.description: A team of AI judges compares the generated takes of each shot and picks the best one

TimelineRender.label: Render Timeline
TimelineRender.description: Turn a timeline from the editor into a finished video file

DesignSystem.label: Brand & product profile
DesignSystem.description: Reads your design files and app structure into a brand and product profile the later steps use (free)

ExtractFrame.label: Grab a frame
ExtractFrame.description: Save one frame of a video as an image, to reuse as a picture, a cover or the first frame of a new clip (free)

AudioGenerate.label: Generate music or sound
AudioGenerate.description: Generate music or a sound effect from a description (paid, with a spending limit)

ImageGenerate.label: Generate or edit a picture
ImageGenerate.description: Make pictures from a description, or change one picture by an instruction (paid, with a spending limit)

PinInsert.label: Put on screens
PinInsert.description: Put a video or image on the tracked screens of your footage, without an AI model (free)

VideoEnhance.label: Enhance video
VideoEnhance.description: Sharpen the picture: make it bigger, smoother, cleaner or less choppy

AudioCleanup.label: Clean up audio
AudioCleanup.description: Fix hum, wind, hiss, echo or a rough voice, or keep only the voice or remove music
